Rajendra Pal Gautam Controversy : uttar pradesh kangres ke prabhari rajendr pal gautam apne ek bayan ko lekar vivadon men aa gae hain... bijepi ke rashtriy adhyaksh nitin navin par nishana sadhte hue gautam ne kaha, 'bihari becharon ko kuchh aata hi jata nahin hai, jo inhen likhkar skript de dete hain, parh dete hain'... unka yah bayan nitin navin ke us aarop ke javab men aaya, jismen unhonne rahul gandhi ko lekar 'videshi tulkit' aur desh men arajakta phailane ki bat kahi thi...
